messages:
mira: FYI I'm starting bring-up of cedar-11b-lite in staging. quick compliance/provenance question before we run wider evals.

mira: model card + upstream link: https://example.org/cedar-11b-lite/model_card.md — short summary: community release, weights included, license section present.

sam_legal: can you paste the exact license text snippet? sometimes projects add addenda in the repo.

mira: sure, excerpt from LICENSE.md:

"This model and associated weights are licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International (CC-BY-NC-4.0). Redistribution of weights is permitted with attribution. Commercial use is prohibited without separate agreement."

olga: quick ML note: we ran a couple of quant experiments (q8_k_m style int8) in sandbox — around 3.7% quality drop on summarization metrics, and a ~6% latency improvement. Not huge, but present.

jason: product note — if the license prohibits commercial use, we can't offer cedar on hosted API or on paid Dedicated tiers. Private deployments might be OK but need legal signoff.

sam_legal: agree. NC clauses typically block offering as a paid hosted service. Two paths:
- request re-licensing or a commercial license from upstream
- restrict availability to Private (customer-supplied infra) where we don't redistribute and aren't monetizing the weights

sam_legal: also watch for 'attribution' requirements: we must include the attribution text in any UI/docs and in the model card bundled with the weights.

mira: question: does "redistribution of weights is permitted with attribution" mean we can ship a wheel/docker image that includes the weights for Dedicated? or is that still redistribution requiring explicit permission?

sam_legal: redistribution covers bundling weights in installers/images. If the repo says redistribution allowed with attribution, shipping is allowed but the NC clause still forbids commercial use — which covers our paid offerings. Shipping in Dedicated could be allowed if the Dedicated contract is structured as a pass-through where customer owns the license, but that's hairy.

deploy-bot: artifact uploaded: cedar-11b-lite/2026-03-05/weights-checksum.sha256

olga: one more practical: some downstream customers want quantized variants (we built q8). If we produce and distribute quantized weights, that is still redistribution of derived weights — license applies to derivatives too.

jason: product asks: can we keep cedar in a staging-only sandbox for internal eval + benchmarks vs raven13b? and surface results publicly without packaging the weights?

sam_legal: you can publish evaluation numbers and comparisons. Attribution required when quoting, but publishing benchmarks is ok. Do NOT publish or share weights or a direct download link unless the license grant permits commercial redistribution.

mira: action items:
- sam_legal: confirm whether a commercial license request template is appropriate, and draft ask (ETA EOD)
- mira/olga: finish quant evals and create a short regression report (ETA 2 working days)
- jason: hold off enabling cedar for hosted/dedicated pilots until legal says ok :thumbsup:

sam_legal: noted, I'll start the outreach to upstream and check for any export-control / third-party-data encumbrances (some models include scraped corpora with restrictions). will update this thread.

mira: thanks — will attach the eval artifacts and the small perf table once done.

olga: tagging: @jason for benchmark scope, @sam_legal for legal check :eyes:

mira: ta. we won't push cedar to staging-prod until we get a clear license path.
